selection_rule: Smallest evaluated candidate with dimensions divisible by 16 and 100% development coverage at a symmetric 20 mm per-side margin.
geometry_gates_during_preprocessing: CT and mask must have identical voxel-array shape before any derived reheader.
CT and mask orientation must match.
Exact physical matches use the original geometry.
Index-aligned header mismatches use a derived mask reheader without voxel resampling.
Shape or orientation mismatches are critical failures and must be quarantined.
Every corrected ROI must fit the locked crop with at least a 20 mm symmetric margin.

known_header_mismatch.action: COPY CT GEOMETRY TO DERIVED MASK HEADER WITHOUT RESAMPLING VOXELS

anti_leakage_policy: Ground-truth masks may define crop-size geometry only in the development cohort.
Ground-truth masks must not determine crop centres during validation scoring or test inference.
No test-specific crop size, spacing, margin, or centring adjustment is permitted.
A deployment-compatible pancreas localisation and centring rule must be locked before model evaluation.
next_required_stage: Lock deployment-compatible ROI localisation and crop-centre protocol.
